q: A buyer wants our carbon data in a week. What can we send that holds up?
title: Carbon data needed in a week
short: Send Scope 1 and 2 from last year's electricity bills and fuel invoices, which most firms can total in days. Add a short note on what is included, what is estimated and when Scope 3 will follow. A smaller, sourced figure on time beats a full but guessed one.

ol: Day 1 to 2: collect twelve months of bills and fuel invoices.
Day 3: calculate Scope 1 and 2 by site.
Day 4: second person checks units and factors.
Day 5: send with a method note and a date for Scope 3.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site, and labels estimates as estimates.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
